hook (0–2 s): evening courtyard; a coiled rope on the floor; ZOOM PUNCH on Gopi's face, screen SHAKE on each 'పాము!', he leaps onto the cot, sweat drops fly, speed lines; title pill 'నాగుల చవితి స్పెషల్ 🐍'
hook-twist: Pinky picks up the rope and dangles it; record-scratch SFX; a big '🪢 తాడు!' label pops; Gopi frozen mid-pose on the cot
hold: Gopi still on the cot, clutching a pillow; tag 'చివర్లో GREETING 🎁 👀' bounces in; small calendar flips '13 నాగుల చవితి · 14 నాగుల పంచమి'
family: Amma at the doorway, hands on hips, ladle in hand (bossy, warm); alarm-clock icon '5:00 AM ⏰' rings
comedy: Gopi snuggled under a blanket, a 'zzz' bubble; on 'పుట్ట అంటే… పాము?!' his eyes pop wide, blanket flies off

punchline: Pinky laughing, points at Gopi; label 'BRAVE: 🐍 > అన్నయ్య' with a medal on the snake's trail
follow: animated FOLLOW + SUBSCRIBE buttons tapped by a hand; Gopi gives a sheepish thumbs-up
comment-countdown: '💬 COMMENT NOW' + big 3-second countdown (no voice during it); a sunny paddy field with a ❓ over a smiling farmer; comment bubbles pop: '🌾?', '🐭?', '🤔'
guess: Pinky bubble 'అన్నయ్యని భయపెట్టడానికి!' → playful red ✗ + boing SFX (Gopi pouts)
reveal: 'ANSWER ✅' banner; in the field a cartoon rat nibbling the crop runs off as the friendly snake glides in; the paddy stands tall and green; label 'ఎలుకల్ని తింటుంది → పంట సేఫ్ 🌾'
check: small tag 'పాములు wildlife 🐍 దూరం నుంచే గౌరవం 🙏'; big ✅ sticker
share: an Instagram-story-style frame (generic, no logos) with the greeting card inside + a share arrow to a 'Family 👨‍👩‍👧' bubble
